chapter: Hospital, Miles Davis and Gil Evans
title: Elvin Jones's illness and a recording break
summary: Brief talk about Elvin Jones being gravely ill before a break.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I hear that Elvin is sick.
He’s very sick, isn’t he? Because what I heard is he said he wants to go out on the drums. What a drummer!
Yes, what a drummer, hell of a drummer.
Do we have this on him?
That’s great. I’m glad to hear that.
